title: CiliaKB: A comprehensive knowledge base for cilia-associated genes
content:
by Chun-Jie Liu, Chao Zhang, Wei Feng, Gaoxiang Huang, Xiaopeng Zou, Wenlu Wei, Donghui Zhang

Cilia dysfunction is implicated in a range of disorders. Here, we present CiliaKB, a manually curated knowledge base that serves as a one-stop platform for researchers to rapidly access mechanistic data and mine for translational clues about cilia.
